study type: Algorithm Development and Validation Study using Retrospective Claims Data
cohort: The study included women aged 10-64 years from U.S. IBM MarketScan(r) Commercial Claims and Encounters and Multi-State Medicaid databases during 2014 and 2016.
finding: The new algorithms, incorporating the latest ICD-10-CM codes, provide more complete estimates of medication use during pregnancy compared to algorithms using outdated codes, with percentages of most pregnancy outcomes identified being similar to national data sources.
